scope: Focused independent mathematical and literal source-contract review of HED8–HED16; HED6–7 and GUA6/GUA14 were inspected as dependencies.
findings: HED8 matches the full arbitrary-real-shift FrobTwT: arithmetic eigenvalues alpha^{-1}q^t become geometric alpha q^{-t}, with all prolongations and full original inertia. The good-parameter condition follows from the unramified spherical parameter.
HED9 keeps the original cyclotomic convention: epsilon^{-j} has geometric Frobenius value q^j. Rank and all polynomial root multiplicities are preserved.
HED10 chooses one initial representation per cusp, using e=d−n and the original integral infinity-string guard; subsequent string members are exactly its cyclotomic twists.

HED11 compares the supplied continuous R, using only cofinite split degree-one places. GUA6 gives the Speh-quotient parameter as the stated direct sum, and GUA14 gives the full original Frobenius law at spherical initial cusp places.

HED12 legitimately extends a characteristic-polynomial identity from degree-one Frobenius density before applying the abstract field isomorphism. No replacement of the supplied R by its semisimplification is needed.

HED13 uses BCS8 strict |t|<1/2, exact compact-fixed tensor factors BCS14, GUA12 spherical-segment singleton theorem, and BCS15 normalized Satake roots. Unit characters have norm one, giving strict q^{-1/2}<|alpha|<q^{1/2}.

HED14 correctly removes the split restriction through the already global polynomial identity. The finite exceptional set is chosen before arbitrary b,z,z-prime; positive common lower bounds prove nonvanishing and the exact strict ratio.

HED15 retains all original positive ranks and lengths, odd ell including3, same given R and all split local components. HED16 transfers the same-point full determinant and uses the exact original rank/length relabeling in ArithmeticPointDecomposition.
limitations: Retained original base-change, polarized attachment and local classification foundations are not independently reproved by this review.
This review is a human mathematical/source-scope check; no Lean replay or claim of unconditional RH/GRH.
